notes: Minifigures (Gandalf, Frodo with their heads, hats, cape, beard, torsos and legs) are not in the supplied parts list and are not recorded.

Book (b72) is held by Frodo and bar 6L (b73) is Gandalf's staff. The booklet builds one model, so the L3 'separate groups' finding came from these two loose accessories. I linked them to the cart with loose, unfastened contact joins: the staff leans on seat panel b51 and the book stands beside wheel b62. Their rests_on stays [] because they clutch nothing.

Many exact stud positions in the cart base are inferred from small isometric drawings. The base is read as 4 studs wide: a 2x6 centre strip (b4) with a tan 2x4 and the pin plate laid across it. The 2x10 and the two 1x8 plates then sit on top. Treat the rests_on lists for b4 to b26 as best estimates.

The four 1x1 clip-plate units (b33 to b44) are assumed to sit on the tan 2x4 plates b15 and b16. In each unit one brick sits on the clip plate's stud (and carries a round plate in step 16) and the other brick is held sideways in the clip.
Hitch b48: the 2x2 end sits on the cart's reddish-brown 2x10 front end (b10). The 1x2 end rests on the horse's back plate b3 (step 18), which joins the horse to the cart.
Barrel b50 sits on jumper b26 and the backpack b49 on jumper b25. The letter tile b61 is assumed to sit on dark tan plate b17. Both are uncertain.

Bars b68 and b69 and snake b67 are simply pushed into the barrel's open top. Green round brick b64 and green cone b65 sit on the light bluish gray bar b69, and white cone b66 sits on the yellow bar b68.

Side walls b27/b30 and tailgate b45 are built upside-down as separate sub-assemblies. Their handle plates are listed as resting on the base plate in build order. The assignment of which pair of 92280 clips holds which wall is inferred. The carrot (b70) is assumed to clip onto the edge of tan plate b16.
